instruction: From the command line, use /home/user/Desktop/tilearray.png as the input. Split it into three equal vertical panels, apply a warm‑tone adjustment that increases from left to right (left = least warm, middle = medium, right = warmest), and then stitch the three panels back together in that left‑to‑right order without adding borders or changing the overall size. Save the result exactly as a PNG at /home/user/Desktop/rearranged.png.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);
